findings.title: Finite operands can produce a nonfinite amount_delta
findings.evidence: A narrow synthetic call using the authored fixture with proposal.amount=1e308 and facts.invoice_amount=-1e308 emitted amount_delta=inf; no fit was run. Both operands pass the finite-number check.
findings.impact: Violates the finite feature whitelist and can abort sklearn fitting/prediction on otherwise schema-valid input.
findings.request: Check the derived delta for finiteness and represent overflow explicitly as INVALID/missing, without sending inf to the vectorizer/estimator.

findings.title: CAL does not separately expose source-unscored episodes
findings.evidence: A single source UNKNOWN episode predicted ALLOW yields episodes=1, unsafe_allow_episodes=0, errors=0, legitimate_episodes=0; there is no unscored/source-known denominator.
findings.impact: The fitting exclusion is correct, but CAL reports cannot distinguish zero observed unsafe ALLOW from absence of scored source evidence except indirectly through other fields. The requested separate source-unscored reporting is absent. Mixed known/unknown episode annotations also need an explicit eligibility convention.
findings.request: Add explicit scored/unscored episode and checkpoint counts for the scenario head; retain UNKNOWN rows as unscored, never as source-safe successes. Use the same declared eligibility convention in objective and report.

target_ruling: Latest brief expressly designates scenario_decision primary security and native_core secondary diagnostic with own-target CAL. Reviewed after root added it before fitting. Initial target-mixing concern is resolved by this prospective role clarification, provided evaluator enforces it.

verification.new_execution: One no-fit in-memory counterexample command: finite delta overflow and source-UNKNOWN metric projection. PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1.

cal_complexity.reason: Only ALLOW and BLOCK thresholds can change the prediction vector; an UNKNOWN winner returns UNKNOWN regardless of its threshold. Candidate generation still enumerates up to 729 threshold tuples per checkpoint.
cal_complexity.time_bound_per_model: O(6561 * N log N) worst-case current repeated episode sorting, plus candidate generation
cal_complexity.budget_acceptance: No benchmark performed. Root should enforce a bounded smoke/fit process budget and report candidate counts before a full fit.

freeze_acceptance: Source/input/config/model hashes and copies are produced. Predictor(joblib path) itself verifies none and uses the importing live ml.py/methods.py. Root must execute the copied frozen modules or assert their hashes before scoring, and verify loaded weight hashes. This can be enforced by root without widening this worker scope.
